name: Driven wheel rotational status (ABS)
signals: b1-b3 and b5-b7 are 24-bit counters whose rate follows vehicle speed (r=1.00): wheel rotation/distance accumulators; b0 and b4 high bits = rolling counter; B0-3 left, B4-7 right: 2-bit rollover, 2-bit seq, reset, valid, 10-bit pulse count, 16-bit timestamp.

name: Non-driven wheel rotational status (ABS)
signals: b1-b3 and b5-b7 are 24-bit counters whose rate follows vehicle speed (r=1.00): wheel rotation/distance accumulators; b0 and b4 high bits = rolling counter; same layout as 0C1.

name: Transmission output rotational status (TCM)
signals: b1-b3 is a 24-bit counter whose rate follows vehicle speed (r=1.00); b0 counter; B0 b7-6 direction 1 fwd 2 rev; b3 reset, b2 valid; 10-bit pulse count from B0 b1; B2-3 timestamp.
notes: all zero key-on Sender: TCM (disappears with the TCM fuses pulled, fuse test 2026-10-14). Source GMW8762 (GM PPEI spec 2011).

name: Engine torque limit request 1 (TCM to ECM)
signals: Torque-limit request (7 bytes, about 40 Hz): b0 bits7-6 = 2-bit alive counter, bits5-4 = request flag (1 = active), b0 low nibble + b1 = 12-bit limit (0xFFF = no limit). b4-b5 = 0x3001 minus the counter (fixed check bytes, not data). Same first two bytes as 199 in 22,393 of 22,393 pairs.
notes: Found by an outside review, verified here: flag/limit drop during shifts (2->3 power upshifts at 3,500-4,300 RPM: raw about 1986-2108 = 145-205 Nm if raw*0.5-848; 2->1 stop downshifts at about 800-900 RPM: about 40-80 Nm); events last 25-575 ms. Sender confirmed as the TCM by the fuse test; Nm scaling still to be cross-checked against HP Tuners. Limit scaling measured: Nm = raw x 0.5 - 848 (engine torque on 191 follows it within 2 Nm). Check word: b4-b5 = 0x4000 - b2-b3 - counter (holds engine-on with b2-b3 = 0FFF and engine-off with 1976). Sender: TCM (disappears with the TCM fuses pulled, fuse test 2026-10-14). 2026-10-15 drive: ~50 frames with flag 1 and limits 20-94 Nm during shifts at light throttle (factory shift torque management). 47 limit frames, 46-203 Nm, incl. a 33%-pedal 2-3 shift near 4200 rpm. Verified 2026-10-21 against HP Tuners on the same drive: 13 TCM requests on the drive: the ECM pulled spark only (Torque Mgt Advance = spark drop, up to 38 deg for a -22 lb-ft limit at 4,800 rpm), about 4-5 deg per 10 lb-ft cut. Factory TCM->ECM response: limit reached 5-105 ms after the request (median ~60 ms), same range as our emulator (~90 ms).

notes: b3 matches our shifter log and a pcmhacking.net thread; b0 also reads 0F P / 0E R / 0D N; L seen at 522-536 s of the 10.6-minute drive and 62-64 s of the 6:43 PM log; in L, byte 0 high-nibble bits (0x20/0x40) and byte 1 high nibble 2 (downshift pending) change with paddle commands Sender: TCM (disappears with the TCM fuses pulled, fuse test 2026-10-14). 2026-10-15 drive: B0 low nibble = current gear 1-6 (reached 6th in L), 15 in Park.
